counter_evidence.fact: Alaska Commerce Commissioner Julie Sande, writing three months after the proclamation, confirms the BEAD broadband buildout is still in progress: more than $1 billion allocated, over $629 million awarded to fifteen subgrantees, twenty-nine deployment projects aiming to connect more than 46,000 homes and small businesses, and around 70% of BEAD locations from Utqiagvik to Metlakatla expected online within three years. She calls high-speed internet historically 'a luxury in many Alaska communities.'
counter_evidence.outlet: Juneau Empire — Op-Ed by Commissioner Julie Sande, Alaska DCCED

counter_evidence.fact: FCC Form 477-derived data shows only 68.5% of Alaskans have access to broadband meeting the FCC 25/3 Mbps standard, meaning roughly three in ten Alaska residents cannot purchase qualifying broadband service today.
